summaries: A deadly knock-out green fog hits the town. The boy runs bare-foot up to an old water tower to escape the low-lying gas, but finds the top hatch padlocked as the fog climbs up toward him.

The boy breaks the padlock with his backpack and climbs into the water tower tank, closing the hatch. However, a rusty pipe inside ruptures, spraying toxic green gas inside the closed space, and the hatch jams shut, trapping him inside with the poison gas.
arc.title: Toxic Green Fog
